line: Crowley's Seven of Swords is the card for the third decan of Aquarius, with the Moon as its planet in the sign.

sections.title: Crowley's card for this decan
sections.line: Crowley's chapter gives the title and the planet in Aquarius.

quotes.quote: The Seven of Swords is called Futility.
the celestial rule of the Moon in Aquarius

sections.title: What the card is, in his words
sections.line: His description of what the card figures, as the card chapter gives it.

quotes.quote: The intellectual wreckage of the card is thus not so vehement as in the Five.
